Description.value: Server-side: when a party member opens a container, the learning perks of every active member count - as extra draws on top of the opener's vanilla loot, so nothing is replaced or lost (best value per perk, never stacked). Skill magazines and perk books; optionally all other perk-weighted loot (ammo, weapons, tools, ...) too. Shared Reading lets the whole party learn from one read. Singleplayer stays vanilla.
